Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: pilots for the 'Kudos + Keepsakes' program this quarter. Managers: nominate up to 2 people with a 1-line reason and pick gift: pin / digital-badge / donation. Please fill this sheet: https://tiny.redwood/kudos-pilot by Thu EOD.
Theo: Quick Q: do digital badges appear in Slack profile or HRIS?
Maya (People Ops): They'll be both — Slack flair and HRIS public profile. We'll include instructions on how to accept.
Iris: For internationals, prefer donation or badge because shipping is slow.
Maya (People Ops): Noted. We'll default to donation for non-US unless manager opts in and covers customs. Add "ship_physical" flag in the sheet.
Ben (Finance): Budget note: $30 per award cap unless approved. Any physical overages need finance sign-off.
LogiBot: [system] Inventory: pins=75, mugs=30, digital_badge_templates=5. Lead time for new pin run: 11 business days.
Theo: Can managers nominate contractors?
Maya (People Ops): Yes, contractors who are active in the last 60 days are eligible; mark contractor=Y in the sheet. Finance will handle tax/reporting accordingly.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate on Fri and send final list to Finance. :sparkles:
